resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1925 newspaper item says a house was being built for a lookout, while the register, firelookout.com and cherylhill.net date the earlier L-4 cabin to 1934. The story reports both and does not reconcile them.

sources.title: Harl Butte – Every Lookout in Oregon

notes_for_editor: Dates: 1925 newspaper item (house being built for a lookout) vs 1934 first L-4 cabin per three sites; the 1954 cab is consistent across all four sources. Elevation: NHLR 5,983 ft (1,824 m) matches the record's 1823.6 m; cherylhill.net gives 6,071 ft, not used. Access 'public' is inferred from the staffed status and a 2023 visit; gate status and road end are unverified. Staffer's and families' names in the newspaper items are left out. josephoregon.us appeared in search results but was not read or cited. Oregon Lookouts newspaper quotes come via that page, not the original papers.
